static string DescribeGetOrCompute()
    {
        return "Uses ConcurrentDictionary.GetOrAdd(TKey, Func<TKey,TValue>) which "
             + "atomically returns the existing value if the key is present, or "
             + "invokes the valueFactory delegate to create and add a new value. "
             + "The valueFactory may be invoked on multiple threads simultaneously "
             + "for the same key under contention, but only one value is stored — "
             + "extra invocations are wasted. GetOrAdd is NOT atomic with respect "
             + "to the factory: the delegate can execute more than once. "
             + "Throws ArgumentNullException if key is null.";
    }

static string DescribeParseDate()
    {
        return "Uses Regex.Match(string, string) which returns a single Match object "
             + "(never null — check Match.Success). Named capture groups (?<name>...) "
             + "are accessed via Match.Groups[string] returning a Group object whose "
             + ".Value is the captured string (empty string if group did not participate). "
             + "Groups[0] always holds the entire match. Regex.Match uses the interpreted "
             + "regex engine by default (not compiled). The static Regex.Match method "
             + "auto-caches the last 15 regex patterns. Throws ArgumentNullException if "
             + "input or pattern is null, and RegexMatchTimeoutException on timeout.";
    }

static string DescribeBuildPath()
    {
        return "Uses Enumerable.Aggregate<TSource,TAccumulate,TResult>(seed, func, resultSelector) "
             + "— the three-parameter overload. The seed ('root') is the initial accumulator value "
             + "and its type (TAccumulate) can differ from TSource. The func lambda is invoked "
             + "sequentially for each element: (accumulator, element) => newAccumulator. After all "
             + "elements are processed, the resultSelector projects the final accumulator to "
             + "TResult. Throws InvalidOperationException on empty sequence ONLY for the "
             + "seedless overload — the seeded overload returns resultSelector(seed) for empty input. "
             + "Aggregate uses deferred execution only for the source; the accumulation itself is eager.";
    }

static string DescribeJoinValues()
    {
        return "Uses StringBuilder(int capacity) constructor to pre-allocate a 256-char "
             + "internal buffer, avoiding reallocations for small inputs. AppendJoin(string, "
             + "params object[]) appends each element separated by the separator in a single "
             + "pass — unlike string.Join which allocates a new string, AppendJoin mutates "
             + "the StringBuilder in-place. AppendJoin calls ToString() on each element "
             + "(null elements become empty string, not 'null'). Returns the same "
             + "StringBuilder instance for fluent chaining. The capacity auto-doubles "
             + "when exceeded, up to MaxCapacity (default int.MaxValue). "
             + "Throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException if capacity < 0.";
    }

static string DescribeParsePerson()
    {
        return "Uses JsonDocument.Parse(string) which parses JSON into a read-only DOM "
             + "backed by pooled memory from ArrayPool<byte>. JsonDocument implements "
             + "IDisposable — the using statement ensures pooled buffers are returned. "
             + "Accessing JsonElement after disposing JsonDocument throws ObjectDisposedException. "
             + "RootElement returns a JsonElement (a struct, not a class) that references "
             + "the document's internal buffer. GetProperty(string) throws KeyNotFoundException "
             + "if the property does not exist (use TryGetProperty for safe access). "
             + "GetString() returns null for JSON null values, not empty string. "
             + "GetInt32() throws FormatException if the JSON number does not fit in Int32.";
    }

static string DescribeSafeInsert()
    {
        return "Uses Dictionary.TryAdd(TKey, TValue) which returns false without throwing "
             + "if the key already exists — unlike Add which throws ArgumentException for "
             + "duplicate keys. TryAdd is O(1) amortized for hash table insertion. "
             + "Both methods throw ArgumentNullException if the key is null (for reference "
             + "type keys). TryAdd was added in .NET Core 2.0 / .NET Standard 2.1 — it is "
             + "not available in .NET Framework 4.x. Dictionary is NOT thread-safe; "
             + "concurrent writes require ConcurrentDictionary or explicit locking. "
             + "The EqualityComparer<TKey>.Default is used when no comparer is specified.";
    }

static string DescribeRunAll()
    {
        return "Uses Task.WhenAll(IEnumerable<Task<TResult>>) which returns a single Task<TResult[]> "
             + "that completes when ALL input tasks complete. The result array preserves the "
             + "original task order (not completion order). If any task faults, WhenAll awaits "
             + "ALL tasks before throwing — the thrown exception is an AggregateException "
             + "but await unwraps it to the FIRST inner exception only. To see all exceptions, "
             + "inspect Task.Exception.InnerExceptions. If any task is canceled, the combined "
             + "task is canceled (TaskCanceledException). WhenAll with an empty collection "
             + "returns an immediately completed task with an empty array.";
    }

static string DescribeCompareVersions()
    {
        return "Version.Parse(string) parses 'major.minor[.build[.revision]]' where "
             + "major and minor are required. Unparsed components default to -1 (not 0), "
             + "so '1.0' has Build=-1 and Revision=-1. CompareTo compares component by "
             + "component: Major, then Minor, then Build, then Revision. A component of "
             + "-1 (undefined) is considered LESS than 0, so '1.0' < '1.0.0' because "
             + "Build -1 < Build 0. This means '1.0' and '1.0.0' are NOT equal. "
             + "Parse throws FormatException for invalid input, ArgumentNullException "
             + "for null, and OverflowException if a component exceeds Int32.MaxValue.";
    }

static string DescribeFindOrInsertionPoint()
    {
        return "Uses Array.BinarySearch(Array, Object) which performs O(log n) binary search "
             + "on a SORTED array. Returns the zero-based index if found. If NOT found, returns "
             + "the bitwise complement (~) of the index of the next element larger than the value, "
             + "which is always a negative number. The caller applies ~ to recover the insertion "
             + "point. The array MUST be sorted in ascending order — behavior on unsorted arrays "
             + "is undefined, not an exception. Uses IComparable interface for element comparison. "
             + "For duplicate values, the index of ANY matching element may be returned (not "
             + "necessarily the first or last).";
    }

static string DescribeSafeCopy()
    {
        return "Array.ConstrainedCopy provides atomicity: either ALL elements are copied or "
             + "NONE are (the destination is unchanged on failure). This differs from Array.Copy "
             + "which may leave the destination partially modified if an exception occurs mid-copy. "
             + "ConstrainedCopy requires that source and destination have the EXACT same type "
             + "(no widening conversions like int[] to long[] allowed, unlike Array.Copy which "
             + "permits compatible widening). Both methods throw ArgumentException for rank "
             + "mismatch and ArrayTypeMismatchException for incompatible element types. "
             + "ConstrainedCopy is a constrained execution region (CER) guarantee.";
    }

static string DescribeGrowArray()
    {
        return "Array.Resize<T>(ref T[], int) does NOT resize the array in-place. It allocates "
             + "a NEW array of the specified size, copies elements from the old array (up to "
             + "Math.Min(old.Length, newSize)), and assigns the new array to the ref parameter. "
             + "The ORIGINAL array object is unchanged — any other variable still referencing it "
             + "sees the old data and old length. New elements in a grown array are initialized to "
             + "default(T) (0 for int, null for reference types). If newSize equals the current "
             + "length, a new array is still allocated. If newSize is 0, the ref parameter is set "
             + "to an empty array (not null).";
    }

static string DescribeCreateLookup()
    {
        return "Uses StringDictionary which automatically LOWERCASES all keys on Add, "
             + "ContainsKey, and indexer access. 'Hello' and 'hello' map to the SAME entry — "
             + "Add('Hello','x') followed by Add('hello','y') throws ArgumentException for "
             + "duplicate key. This differs from Dictionary<string,string> which is case-SENSITIVE "
             + "by default. Values are NOT lowercased, only keys. StringDictionary implements "
             + "IEnumerable but NOT IDictionary<string,string> — it is a legacy collection from "
             + ".NET 1.0 using DictionaryEntry for enumeration (not KeyValuePair). "
             + "ContainsValue is case-SENSITIVE. Null keys throw ArgumentNullException, "
             + "but null values are allowed.";
    }
